backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods or state.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking product requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file providing short descriptions of key frontend components, utilities, and styling files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS setup defining design tokens, color variables, and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title and mounts the React application.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app wrapper rendering the header, landing page, and footer in a full-height layout.
frontend/src/components/DataPlansSection: Renders a grid of predefined mobile data plans with features and WhatsApp purchase links.
frontend/src/components/IBNFooter.tsx: Footer with brand info, quick links, contact details, social icons, and dynamic WhatsApp support links.
frontend/src/components/IBNHeader.tsx: Sticky top header showing the IBN logo, brand name, and a WhatsApp contact button.
frontend/src/components/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page including hero, about, data plans, and CTA sections with branding and feature highlights.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppCTA.tsx: Reusable button component generating WhatsApp chat links with optional size, number display, and custom message.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and provider for managing Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and stored identity restoration.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder file for future React Query hooks; currently empty.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and custom color variables for light and dark themes using OKLCH values.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Generates a WhatsApp chat URL for a fixed Nigerian phone number with optional prefilled text.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app, wrapping it with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, plugins, and container settings.
project_state.json: Stores project metadata, features, requirements, and design goals for the IBN application.
